items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: Now, see, there's a big difference in Bird and Diz. Bird swang. Diz never could swing.

ctx.x: But there's another thing. After all, your rhythm section was putting down a solid beat. It wasn't what the beboppers did later, was it?

No. Well, that's what I was going to say. Now you see, here's what. A lot of people don't think about this. Now, see, there's a big difference in Bird and Diz. Bird swang. Diz never could swing. Diz is a technical musician. He's a good technical musician. He can run up and down that horn, you know what I mean?
